title: Long-term region-specific mitochondrial respiration impairment after perinatal asphyxia is prevented by the NAD⁺ donor nicotinamide riboside: A real-time organotypic metabolic profiling approach.
design: preclinical animal study (neonatal rat perinatal asphyxia model with organotypic cortical cultures)

outcomes.name: mitochondrial respiration (basal, ATP-linked, maximal, spare respiratory capacity)
outcomes.effect_text: effectively prevented PA-induced mitochondrial respiration deficits

outcomes.name: regional neurochemical integrity (nigrostriatal neurocircuitry)
outcomes.effect_text: preserved regional neurochemical integrity, particularly within the nigrostriatal neurocircuitry
